contract.title: 3-bit ripple-carry adder
contract.description: Build a 3-bit adder. Levers A0..A2 (bit 0 = least significant) and B0..B2 and carry-in lever CIN are inputs; lamps S0..S2 show the sum bits and lamp COUT the carry out, i.e. (COUT S2 .. S0) = A + B + CIN as binary numbers. The devices are fixed; connect them. Library hint (component tier only): a full-adder cell is available.
